risk_note: RV1 (agent). B1-10u (D10-1382 ②, D10-1399 (a); BR-ID-15 ④): the one 'is this AI reply report overdue' rule (pending, reported_at set, now >= reported_at + 48 h, injected clock) and the per-app count, exported from agent/index.ts. application/report-overdue.ts is now the only source of the 48-hour constant, the deadline and the cutoff; the admin report list (B1-10t) calls it for each row's overdue / deadline_at and for the overdue filter. countOverdueAgentReports and the list's total share one store query (countReports, app-scoped, status=pending, overdue=true), so the workbench card agent_report_overdue equals the list's total. Read only. Host (local-heavy): integration spec/agent/report-overdue + admin-reports 15/15, decide + foreign-db-handoff rule 23, agent unit 567, tsc -b apps/api test / depcruise 0. The implementation was a fresh desktop Claude subagent (model opus) in place of claude -p on the terminal accounts (DESKTOP-common-20261113).
